title: Doraji Tagine
description: A flavorful North African-inspired stew from India, featuring the unique flavor of doraji root. This hearty dish is perfect for a cold winter night.

ingredients.name: tagine
ingredients.notes: use of a tagine is optional, but recommended for authentic flavor

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add ginger and garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add sliced doraji and cook for 5 minutes, or until slightly tender.
Add algerian spices, tomato paste (if using), and salt. Stir to combine.
Pour in light ingredients and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until doraji is tender.
Season with additional salt if needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs (if desired).
